mn121:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Pubbārāme Migāramātu pāsāde.
mn121:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando sāyaṇhasamayaṃ patisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn121:3.1: Ekamidaṃ, bhante, samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati. Nagarakaṃ nāma Sakyānaṃ nigamo.
mn121:3.2: Tattha me, bhante, Bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:
mn121:3.4: Kacci me taṃ, bhante, sussutaṃ suggahītaṃ sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritan ti?
mn121:3.5: Taggha te etaṃ, Ānanda, sussutaṃ suggahītaṃ sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ.
mn121:3.6: Pubbe cāhaṃ, Ānanda, etarahi ca suññatāvihārena bahulaṃ viharāmi.
mn121:4.1: Seyyathāpi ayaṃ Migāramātu pāsādo suñño hatthigavāssavaḷavena, suñño jātarūparajatena, suñño itthipurisasannipātena; atthi c' ev' idaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ
mn121:4.3: evam eva kho, Ānanda, bhikkhu amanasikaritvā gāmasaññaṃ amanasikaritvā manussasaññaṃ araññasaññaṃ paṭicca manasikaroti ekattaṃ.
mn121:4.4: Tassa araññasaññāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati.
mn121:4.6: Ye assu darathā gāmasaññaṃ paṭicca, te 'dha na santi; ye assu darathā manussasaññaṃ paṭicca, te 'dha na santi; atthi c' evāyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ
mn121:4.8: So: Suññam idaṃ saññāgataṃ gāmasaññāyāti pajānāti; Suññam idaṃ saññāgataṃ manussasaññāyāti pajānāti. Atthi c' ev' idaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ
mn121:4.10: Iti yaṃ hi kho tattha na hoti, tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati; yaṃ pana tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti, Taṃ santaṃ idam atthīti pajānāti.
mn121:4.11: Evam pi 'ssa esā, Ānanda, yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā suññatāvakkanti bhavati.
mn121:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ, Ānanda, bhikkhu amanasikaritvā manussasaññaṃ amanasikaritvā araññasaññaṃ paṭhavīsaññaṃ paṭicca manasikaroti ekattaṃ.
mn121:5.2: Tassa paṭhavisaññāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati.
mn121:5.3: Seyyathāpi, Ānanda, usabhacammaṃ saṃkusatena suvihataṃ vigatavasikaṃ; --
mn121:5.4: evam eva kho, Ānanda, bhikkhu yam imissā paṭhaviyā ukkūlavikūlaṃ nadīviduggaṃ khāṇukaṇṭakādhāraṃ pabbatavisamaṃ, taṃ sabbaṃ amanasikaritvā paṭhavīsaññaṃ paṭicca manasikaroti ekattaṃ.
mn121:5.5: Tassa paṭhavīsaññāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati.
mn121:5.7: Ye assu darathā manussasaññaṃ paṭicca te 'dha na santi; ye assu darathā araññasaññaṃ paṭicca te 'dha na santi; atthi c' evāyaṃ darathamattā, yadidaṃ
mn121:5.9: So: Suññam idaṃ saññāgataṃ manussasaññāyāti pajānāti; Suññam idaṃ saññāgataṃ araññasaññāyāti pajānāti. Atthi c' ev' idaṃ asuññataṃ, yadidaṃ
mn121:5.11: Iti yaṃ hi kho tattha na hoti, tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati; yam pana tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti, Taṃ santaṃ idam atthīti pajānāti.
mn121:5.12: Evam pi 'ssa esā, Ānanda, yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā suññatāvakkan ti bhavati.
mn121:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ, Ānanda, bhikkhu amanasikaritvā araññasaññaṃ amanasikaritvā paṭhavīsaññaṃ ākāsānañcāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca manasikaroti ekattaṃ.
mn121:6.2: Tass ākāsānañcāyatanasaññāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati.
mn121:6.4: Ye assu darathā araññasaññaṃ paṭicca te 'dha na santi; ye assu darathā paṭhavīsaññaṃ paṭicca te 'dha na santi; atthi c' evāyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ
mn121:6.6: So: Suññam idaṃ saññāgataṃ araññasaññāyāti pajānāti; Suññam idaṃ saññāgataṃ paṭhavīsaññāyāti pajānāti. Atthi c' ev' idaṃ asuññataṃ, yadidaṃ
mn121:6.8: Iti yaṃ hi kho tattha na hoti, tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati; yam pana tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti, Taṃ santaṃ idam atthīti pajānāti.
mn121:6.9: Evam pi 'ssa esā, Ānanda, yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā suññatāvakkan ti bhavati.
mn121:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ, Ānanda, bhikkhu amanasikaritvā paṭhavīsaññaṃ amanasikaritvā ākāsānañcāyatanasaññaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ paṭicca manasikaroti ekattaṃ.
mn121:7.2: Tassa viññāṇañcāyatanasaññāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati.
mn121:7.4: Ye assu darathā paṭhavīsaññaṃ paṭicca te 'dha na santi; ye assu darathā ākāsānañcāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca te 'dha na santi; atthi c' evāyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ
mn121:7.6: So: Suññam idam saññāgataṃ paṭhavīsaññāyāti pajānāti; Suññam idaṃ saññāgataṃ ākāsānañcāyatanasaññāyāti pajānāti. Atthi c' ev' idaṃ asuññataṃ, yadidaṃ
mn121:7.8: Iti yaṃ hi kho tattha na hoti, tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati; yam pana tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti, Taṃ santaṃ idam atthīti pajānāti.
mn121:7.9: Evam pi 'ssa esā, Ānanda, yathābhaccā avipallatthā parisuddhā suññatāvakkan ti bhavati.
mn121:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ, Ānanda, bhikkhu amanasikaritvā ākāsānañcāyatanasaññaṃ amanasikaritvā viññāṇañcāyatanasaññaṃ ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca manasikaroti ekattaṃ.
mn121:8.2: Tassa ākiñcaññāyatanasaññāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati.
mn121:8.4: Ye assu darathā ākāsānañcāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca te 'dha na santi; ye assu darathā viññāṇañcāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca te 'dha na santi; atthi c' evāyaṃ darathamattā, yadidaṃ
mn121:8.6: So: Suññam idaṃ saññāgataṃ ākāsānañcāyatanasaññāyāti pajānāti: Suññam idaṃ saññāgataṃ viññāṇañcāyatanasaññāyāti pajānāti. Atthi c' ev' idaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ
mn121:8.8: Iti yaṃ hi kho tattha na hoti, tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati; yam pi tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti, Taṃ santaṃ idam atthīti pajānāti.
mn121:8.9: Evam pi 'ssa esā, Ānanda, yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā suññatāvakkan ti bhavati.
mn121:9.1: Puna ca paraṃ, Ānanda, bhikkhu amanasikaritvā viññāṇañcāyatanasaññaṃ amanasikaritvā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca manasikaroti ekattaṃ.
mn121:9.2: Tassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati.
mn121:9.4: Ye assu darathā viññāṇañcāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca, te 'dha na santi; ye assu darathā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca te 'dha na santi; atthi c' evāyaṃ darathamattā, yadidaṃ
mn121:9.6: So: Suññam idaṃ saññāgataṃ viññāṇañcāyatanasaññāyāti pajānāti; Suññam idam saññāgataṃ ākiñcaññāsaññāyāti pajānāti. Atthi c' ev' idaṃ asuññataṃ, yadidaṃ
mn121:9.8: Iti yaṃ hi kho tattha na hoti, tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati; yam pi tattha avasitthaṃ hoti, Taṃ santaṃ idam atthīti pajānāti.
mn121:9.9: Evam pi 'ssa esā, Ānanda, yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā suññatāvakkan ti bhavati.
mn121:10.1: Puna ca paraṃ, Ānanda, bhikkhu amanasikaritvā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṃ amanasikaritvā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññaṃ animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ paṭicca manasikaroti ekattaṃ.
mn121:10.2: Tassa animitte cetosamādhimhi cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati.
mn121:10.4: Ye assu darathā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca, te 'dha na santi; ye assu darathā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññaṃ paṭicca, te 'dha na santi; atthi c' evāyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ
mn121:10.5: imam eva kāyaṃ paṭicca saḷāyatanikaṃ jīvitapaccayā ti.
mn121:10.6: So: Suññam idaṃ saññāgataṃ ākiñcaññāyatanasaññāyāti pajānāti; Suññam idaṃ saññāgataṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññāyāti pajānāti. Atthi c' ev' idaṃ asuññataṃ, yadidaṃ
mn121:10.7: imam eva kāyaṃ paṭicca saḷāyatanikaṃ jīvitapaccayā ti.
mn121:10.8: Iti yaṃ hi kho tattha na hoti, tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati; yam pana tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti, Taṃ santaṃ idam atthīti pajānāti.
mn121:10.9: Evam pi 'ssa esā, Ānanda, yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā suññatāvakkan ti bhavati.
mn121:11.1: Puna ca paraṃ, Ānanda, bhikkhu amanasikaritvā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṃ amanasikaritvā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññaṃ animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ paṭicca manasikaroti ekattaṃ.
mn121:11.2: Tassa animitte cetosamādhimhi cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati.
mn121:11.4: Ayam pi kho animitto cetosamādhi abhisaṃkhato abhisañcetayito.
mn121:11.5: Yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṃkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ, tad aniccaṃ nirodhadhamman ti pajānāti.
mn121:11.6: Tassa evaṃ jānato evam passato kāmāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati, bhavāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati, avijjāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati;
mn121:11.8: Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
mn121:12.2: Ye assu darathā kāmāsavaṃ paṭicca, te 'dha na santi; ye assu darathā bhavāsavaṃ paṭicca, te 'dha na santi; ye assu darathā avijjāsavaṃ paṭicca, te 'dha na santi; atthi cevāyaṃ darathamattā, yadidaṃ
mn121:12.3: imam eva kāyaṃ paṭicca saḷāyatanikaṃ jīvitapaccayā ti.
mn121:12.4: So: Suññam idaṃ saññāgataṃ kāmāsavenāti pajānāti; Suññam idaṃ saññāgataṃ bhavāsavenāti pajānāti; Suññam idaṃ saññāgataṃ avijjāsavenāti pajānāti. Atthi c' ev' idaṃ asuññataṃ, yadidaṃ
mn121:12.5: imam eva kāyaṃ paṭicca saḷāyatanikaṃ jīvitapaccayā ti.
mn121:12.6: Iti yaṃ hi kho tattha na hoti, tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati; yam pana tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti, Taṃ santaṃ idam atthīti pajānāti.
mn121:12.7: Evam assa esā, Ānanda, yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā paramānuttarā suññatāvakkan ti bhavati.
mn121:13.1: Ye hi keci, Ānanda, atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja vihariṃsu, sabbe te imaṃ yeva parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja vihariṃsu.
mn121:13.2: Ye hi keci, Ānanda, anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja viharissanti, sabbe te imaṃ yeva parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja viharissanti.
mn121:13.3: Ye hi keci, Ānanda, etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja viharanti, sabbe te imaṃ yeva parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja viharanti.
mn121:13.4: Tasmātiha, Ānanda, Parisuddhaṃ paramānuttaraṃ suññataṃ upasampajja viharissāmīti, -evaṃ
mn121:13.7: Attamano āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti. 122.
